thought: A GOOD SPOT TA CATCH ME BREATH!
ME FEET HAB OPINIONS ABOUT DIS ROAD!
ME WONDER WHAT IZ OVER DAT RIDGE!
WE SHOULD HAB PACKED MORE FOOD!
STILL NO IDEA WHERE WE IZ GOING!
DAT CLOUD LOOKS LIKE A BAD OMEN!
COUNTIN' ME COINS AGAIN. SAME ANSWER!
SOMEONE HAB TA KEEP WATCH. MIGHT AS WELL BE ME!
DIS PLACE SMELLS OLDER DEN IT LOOKS!
ONE DAY ME WILL BE PAID FOR DIS!
greet: EVENIN'. SEEN ANYTHIN' STRANGE AROUND HERE?
IZ DERE ANYWHERE WARM TA EAT NEARBY?
YOU LIVE HERE? WHAT IZ DAT LIKE?
WHICH WAY IZ DA NEAREST ROAD?
reply: STRANGE IZ ALL WE GET HERE!
KEEP TA DA ROAD AN' YOU WILL BE FINE!
YOU IZ NOT FROM AROUND HERE!
ME HAB SAID TOO MUCH ALREADY!
partyGreet: DO YOU EVER THINK ABOUT GOING HOME?
YOU HAB BEEN QUIET ALL DAY!
TELL ME AGAIN WHY WE TOOK DIS ROAD!
ME WOULD NOT HAB MADE IT DIS FAR ALONE!
HOW IZ DAT WOUND OF YA HOLDIN' UP?
IF WE GET PAID, ME IZ BUYIN' DA FIRST ROUND!
DO YOU TRUST DA PEOPLE WE MET BACK DERE?
ME HAB A DREAM ABOUT DIS PLACE. DO NOT ASK!
YOU CARRY TOO MUCH. GIVE ME HALF!
ONE OF DEZE DAYS WE SHOULD STOP FOR A WHOLE WEEK!
partyReply: HOME IZ WHEREVER DA PACKS IZ!
BECAUSE YOU ASKED, AN' ME SAID YES. FOOL DAT ME IZ!
NOR ME. DO NOT LET IT GO TA YA HEAD!
IT HAB STOPPED BLEEDIN', WHICH IZ SOMETHIN'!
YOU SAID DAT IN DA LAST THREE TOWNS!
ME TRUST NOBODY ME NO CAN OUTRUN!
YOU ALWAYS DREAM ABOUT DA WRONG THINGS!
ME CAN MANAGE. ASK ME AGAIN ON DA HILL!
look: HUH. DAT HAB BEEN HERE A WHILE!
ME HAB SEEN ONE OF DEZE BEFORE!
rest: FIVE MINUTES. DAT IZ ALL ME ASK!
DO NOT TELL DA OTHERS ME SAT DOWN!
DIS IZ DA BEST SEAT IN DA COUNTRY!

hunger: ME WAZ STARTIN' TA CHEW ME OWN STRAP!
DAT WILL HOLD ME UNTIL EVENIN'!
DO NOT LOOK AT ME LIKE DAT. ME WAZ HUNGRY!
sleep: WAKE ME IF DA WORLD ENDS.
ME COULD SLEEP FOR A WEEK!
hygiene: ME HAB FORGOTTEN WHAT ME OWN HANDS LOOKED LIKE!
THREE DAYS OF ROAD, OFF AT LAST!
NOW ME IZ FIT TA STAND NEAR PEOPLE!
DAT WATER WAZ COLDER DEN DA GRAVE!
social: DAT IZ DA MOST ME HAB SAID ALL WEEK!
leisure: ME NEEDED DAT MORE DEN ME KNEW!
NOBODY TELL DA PARTY HOW MUCH ME LOST!
FOR A MOMENT DERE ME FORGOT DA ROAD!
